Go to the [Salesforce AppExchange](https://appexchange.salesforce.com/){target="_blank"}. 2. Login with your production Salesforce credentials. 3. Click on your profile picture and select "My Installs & Subscriptions". 4. Click **Manage Subscription** for Blackthorn Compliance. 5. Click **Edit** on the bottom right of your screen. 6. Click **Edit Payment**, and enter the new credit card 7. Click **Review Changes**. 8. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}.
